directory.title: Neighborhood Association Websites

scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: City Office of Neighborhood Coordination recognized Albuquerque neighborhood associations.
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: The actual directory links websites submitted by named recognized Albuquerque associations and coalitions, including Barelas, Downtown, Nob Hill and neighborhood organizations throughout the City.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: Provides a concise gateway to neighborhood organizations participating in City civic and development processes, complementing the existing ONC task-force and facilitated-meetings records.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: The actual resource identifies recognized local organizations and directs readers to their own sites; it is substantive Albuquerque civic participation information, not general municipal context, unrelated jurisdiction or transactional paperwork.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: The maintained City directory materially helps readers locate recognized local neighborhood organizations and their association websites. This is a current civic reference adjacent to existing neighborhood participation and development-review materials. One live directory entry provides useful access without copying a changing roster or creating redundant association entries.

directory.binding_requirement: Approve the exact owner-supplied ONC Neighborhood Association Websites URL as one live-directory resource under Development Process / Current City Review Process. Describe direct access to recognized associations that submitted websites; exclude HOA websites and clarify associations maintain their own sites. No standalone page or copied roster. Link to the reviewed neighborhood map by internal cross-reference only if that map is actually rendered and approved; no duplicate directory entry. Actual visual quality/preview review remains pending before final implemented status.
